summary.intent: Implement a parallel batch upload pipeline for cipher-box (Phase 37): SDK uploadFiles() method with p-limit concurrency and a Web Worker for off-thread AES-256-GCM encryption, then wire the web UI's useDropUpload hook to the new batch API.
summary.outcome: Both plans executed successfully, PR #416 created and merged-ready with 20 unit tests, SDK integration tests, E2E suite, full lint compliance, and 96.4% coverage on uploadFiles(). All 15 CodeRabbit review threads resolved.

repo: p-limit is used for concurrency control in the SDK — max 3 concurrent uploads via UPLOAD_CONCURRENCY constant in client.ts
Web Workers follow the pattern of new Worker(new URL(..., import.meta.url)) — Vite handles this natively with no extra config needed
The existing decrypt-sw.ts service worker has its own tsconfig.sw.json for type-checking — new workers must be added there too
The codebase uses a structured logger, not console.warn/log/error — raw console calls are lint violations
ExternalEncryptFn type lives in @cipherbox/sdk-core and should be reused rather than re-declared inline
FolderMetadata shape requires version and children fields (packages/core/src/folder/types.ts)
addFilePointerToFolder can throw on hash collision and must be wrapped in try/catch to avoid aborting the entire batch
lint:fix treats @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any as warnings not errors, but the team explicitly treats all warnings as errors
Codecov patch coverage is tracked per PR — uncovered lines in new methods will be flagged even if overall coverage is high

code.finding: params.data.length becomes 0 after Transferable buffer transfer — originalSize must be captured before passing data to encryptFn
addFilePointerToFolder wrapped in try/catch — collision errors are non-fatal and should not abort entire batch
Early return when all registrations fail — returns empty succeeded array without attempting folder publish
useDropUpload rewired to call client.uploadFiles() instead of sequential single-file loop
Inline encryption result type was duplicated 4x — now uses ReturnType<ExternalEncryptFn> from sdk-core
encrypt.worker.ts was excluded from tsconfig.json but not added to tsconfig.sw.json — worker type errors were invisible to CI until fixed

workflow: Worktree merges can fail silently when the branch ref isn't updated — cherry-picking by commit hash is a reliable fallback
GSD verifier can produce false negatives when run before cherry-picked commits are visible in the working tree — spot-check files directly before trusting VERIFICATION.md gaps
pnpm lint:fix auto-formats staged files — always commit formatting changes separately from logic fixes to keep diff reviewable
CodeRabbit threads must be explicitly resolved via GraphQL mutation after replying — reply alone does not close the thread
sdk-core must be rebuilt before typechecking sdk or web — build order: sdk-core → sdk → web

friction: Worktree branch ref wasn't updated after agent commits — main branch merge pulled stale HEAD, requiring manual cherry-picks of 3 commits
GSD verifier spawned before cherry-picks were visible, producing 4 false-negative gaps — VERIFICATION.md had to be manually corrected with 10+ edits
Phase completion commands ran on wrong branch (accidentally inside worktree directory) — required reset and redo
TypeScript warnings in test files (as any) were silently ignored by lint:fix instead of being caught as errors — user had to explicitly flag this
encrypt.worker.ts was excluded from all tsconfig files — type errors in the worker were invisible until tsconfig.sw.json was updated
open_items: Web E2E tests not updated for multi-file batch upload flows, partial failure, or cancellation — existing tests only cover serial single-file uploads

Upfront file buffer allocation (all files read into Uint8Array before batch starts) — bounded by MAX_FILE_SIZE (100MB) but should be revisited if batch sizes grow; requires SDK contract change to accept File objects instead of Uint8Array
Blob .buffer usage in apps/web/src/services/upload.service.ts violates apps/web/CLAUDE.md guidance — pre-existing issue, not Phase 37 scope
Secondary pin warning not emitted in batch path (Thread 3 from CodeRabbit) — deferred as low priority
AbortSignal/cancel support for in-flight batch uploads — requires significant SDK changes, deferred
BYO-IPFS pinFn lambda body (lines 870-876 in client.ts) not covered by batch tests — tested indirectly via single-file upload tests but not in batch context
